name: Marcus T.
text: Finally someone addresses the rate limiting issue directly. I've been hitting walls with my bot for months and didn't realize I could use sub-accounts to distribute requests. This is a game changer.

name: Sarah K.
text: Good article but I wish you covered websocket connections more. Are they less prone to rate limiting than REST calls? That's been my main question.

name: David R.
text: The exponential backoff strategy mentioned here saved my trading system. Was getting rate-limited every few hours until I implemented proper retry logic with the timing you suggested.

name: Elena V.
text: Honest question: is there any risk to using multiple API keys on the same account like the guide suggests? Concerned about account security.

name: James W.
text: The weight system explanation cleared up a lot of confusion. Didn't realize some endpoints cost more weight than others. My request batching is way more efficient now.
